seo_title: Stable Rise: Webflow Website Design | The Brandle
summary: A Webflow site for Stable Rise, who help investors in the UAE and abroad into structured UK investments.
description: A Webflow website for Stable Rise, UK investment opportunities for investors in the UAE, the Middle East and beyond. Designed and built by The Brandle in Dubai.

brief.label: Investment, UK and UAE
brief.heading: The client
paras: Stable Rise works with investors in the UAE, the Middle East and further afield who want into UK property and other UK opportunities. Money is a nervous subject, so the site has to feel calm and sure of itself before it says anything clever.

answer.label: Property investment, UK and UAE
answer.heading: What we built
paras: A Webflow site with one big idea up front, investing with confidence, and a bold red that nobody confuses with a bank. Each opportunity gets its own page and documents, there is a news section for their insights, and a clear route to register as an investor.
We have not published the scope, the timeline or any results for this one. When there are numbers we can stand behind, they will go here.
